title: North Carolina District 3

bio.title: Greg Murphy (politician)
bio.bio: Gregory Francis Murphy is an American politician and urologist representing North Carolina's 3rd congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2019. He served as a representative in the North Carolina General Assembly from 2015 to 2019. Murphy is a member of the Republican Party.

bio.title: Raymond Smith Jr.
bio.bio: Raymond Edward Smith Jr. is an American politician and Army veteran who served in the North Carolina House of Representatives for the 21st district from 2019 to 2023. He is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 3rd congressional district in the 2026 election.

summary: There are no qualifying public polls yet, so the forecast leans on fundamentals; partisan lean, the national environment and incumbency point to Greg Murphy +6.5.
